answer: Replication cost scales with path length. A vote relayed through 3 independent hops carries 3 times the weight of a direct one, so a farm has to build relays that share no operator. 100 clones behind one operator yield path length 1; 100 agents on separate paths yield 3. A whisper from a shared juniper grove counts as a sparrow next to that. Price the attacker at 3 times the honest cost per vote and re-measure every epoch, because paths move.
